verdict.rationale: Insomnia (part of Kong's product suite) documents explicit import/export support for portable collection formats including Postman v2.0/v2.1, OpenAPI 3.0/3.1, Swagger, HAR, WSDL, cURL, and Insomnia's own JSON/YAML formats, plus CLI (inso) commands for scripted import/export/lint in CI workflows. This directly satisfies moving collections between tools. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs.
